Name: Perfumery
Author: HarrisonGrey
Description:
[center][i]Want more depth to the Stardew flower ecosystem?
Check out my new [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37426]Murmur of Bees mod[/url]﻿, a Bee House overhaul that lets you give gifts to your bees to upgrade and develop your hive![/i][/center]

Introducing [b]the Perfumery[/b], a new farm building that takes flowers of all kinds and makes perfume out of them.  Based on the traditional deg bhapka method, used since ancient times in India and Persia, you can drop off large quantities of flowers into the large metal container on the left side, and your perfumery will turn them into one of five different flavors of perfume, which collect in the smaller jar on the right side.  Intended as an early game building, the Perfumery is available from the beginning through Robin's shop and requires:

﻿[b]2000 g
[/b]  [b]﻿8 Clay
[/b]  [b]﻿3 Copper Bar
[/b]  [b]﻿1 Geode[/b]

﻿I love the flower-honey system in the game, but I always felt like there could be a little bit more; I appreciate that unlike fruit and vegetable crops, flowers do not store well (due to their unwieldy stacking), so the average 'item to machine to artisan goods' process doesn't feel quite right.  To maintain the passive aspect of the honey-flower system, and the short shelf life of flowers (as represented by terrible storage options), my Perfumery takes the form of a building, allowing you to place a whole harvest of flowers in the building at once and just let them process slowly over the next couple weeks.  Any process related to flowers also feels like it should be aesthetically pleasing, so rather than limited to one simple perfume bottle, flowers are processed into one of five color themed perfumes:

﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/67153256-1755639102.png[/img]﻿

[list]
[*]the red [b]Romantic Perfume[/b]
sells for [b]90g[/b][/*]
[*]the blue [b]Brisk Perfume[/b]
sells for [b]150g[/b][/*]
[*]the yellow [b]Cozy Perfume[/b]
sells for [b]300g[/b][/*]
[*]the orange [b]Rustic Perfume[/b]
sells for [b]450g[/b][/*]
[*]the pink [b]Mystic Perfume[/b]
sells for [b]650g[/b][/*]
[/list]
﻿The perfumes are not directly descended from one specific flower, but rather the flower's in-game color context tag determines which perfume results.  Common colors not represented by the five perfumes above can result in one of a couple appropriate colors (purple flowers make either red or blue perfume).
﻿I've included conversion rules for the most common colors of custom flowers in other mods, so most flowers from Cornucopia, for instance, will still get you a color result that makes sense.  For any flowers with colors not specified by my mod (or without a color at all), they will randomly make one of any of the five perfumes.
﻿While they stack better than the base game flowers, all perfumes still have color variations of their own, inspired by the color variations of the flowers used to make them.  See if you can collect them all!  ﻿
﻿Prices are locked to the item itself and are not inherited from the flower.  Prices were determined based on the vanilla flowers, ranging from around 2x-3x the original price, though with flowers added by mods these prices will vary a lot more widely.  Be careful which modded flowers you turn into perfume, they may not make you a profit.
﻿While this mod is intended more to supplement the existing flower-honey ecosystem within the game rather than become a full on micro-industry, I recognize the prices feel fairly low once you reach a certain point in the game. To balance this, when the right conditions are met, a special order will become available asking for perfumes.  Completing this special order rewards you with a permanent boost to perfume prices.

﻿For aesthetic purposes, this building has seasonal variations and two versions of the design; one that shows an opening to the furnace meant to heat the tank containing the flowers and one that leaves the brickwork intact, with no furnace window.  You can choose which version you want in the Config File (or in-game using the Generic Config Mod Menu).

﻿[b]Config Options[/b]

﻿[b]Sprite[/b]
﻿  ﻿"[i]PerfumeryFire[/i]": Open window into the furnace.  This version of the building also includes a hollow tile on the back of the building for you to place a campfire inside the furnace (which allows your building to act as a light source which buildings cannot normally do).  This is the default option.
﻿  ﻿"[i]Perfumery[/i]": No open window into the furnace or hollow tile on the back for the campfire.
﻿
﻿[b]Daily Production[/b]
﻿  ﻿For players who want a more efficient Perfumery, I've added an option in the config file to change how many perfumes [i]per line[/i] the Perfumery can make each day. The default is 1, but you can select from a range between 1-5.

[b]﻿Perfume Quest[/b]
﻿  You can choose when the Special Order that boosts the price of perfumes shows up.
﻿  ﻿"[i]Mail[/i]": On the first Monday after the conditions are met, you will receive a letter with the Special Order. This is the default.
﻿  ﻿"[i]Board[/i]": Once the conditions are met, the Special Order will be added to the Board rotation and will show up randomly.

[b]Credits[/b]
Me, I did all this.

[b]Translate Me![/b]
This mod has an i18n file and is fully ready to be translated.  Lines include item names, descriptions, quest and special order information, and a few lines of dialogue.

Downloads.Description:
-Added config options for when the perfume Special Order shows up
-Added the ability to configure how many perfumes can be made each day
-Changed the amount of space in the Special Order dropbox
